A pitch detector implemented

The following code shows an example on how to use the pitch detectors implemented in Pandora: PeriodEstimator, WaveletEstimator, ecc.

// pdTest.cpp - A basic example to test pitch detection
//

#include "../lib/include/pandora.h"

#include <stdexcept>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <iostream>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const int OPTIONS = 4;

// some parameters...
//const int WINDOW_SIZE = 1024;
const double MIN_FREQ = 77.782;
const double MAX_FREQ = 1396.91;
const int LEVELS = 1; // not used at the moment
//const double AMP_THRESHOLD = 0.007;
const double SMOOTHINGQUALITY = 0.707;
const double SMOOTHINGRATE = 5000;

int main (int argc, char* argv[]) {
    try {
        cout << "[pdTest, ver. 1.00 - pitch detection test" << endl << endl
             << "written by Carmine E. Cella, 2009" << endl
             << "web: www.cryptosound.org" << endl << endl;

        if (argc != OPTIONS) {
            throw runtime_error ("syntax is 'pdTest file.wav amp win_size'");
        }
        double amp = atof (argv[2]);
        int win = atoi (argv[3]);

        if (0 > amp || 0 > win) {
            throw runtime_error ("invalid threshold or window size");
        }

        cout << "threshold: " << amp << ", window: " << win << endl;

        cout << "opening " << argv[1] << "..." << endl;
        WavInFile* inFile;
        inFile = new WavInFile (argv[1]);
        int bits = (inFile)->getNumBits ();
        double sampleRate = (inFile)->getSampleRate ();
        int channels = (inFile)->getNumChannels ();
        if (bits != 16) {
            throw runtime_error ("invalid input format");
        }
        cout << "total samples: " << inFile->getNumSamples () << endl;

        string mixedName = "frequency.wav";
        cout << "creating " << mixedName << "..." << endl;
        WavOutFile* mixed = new WavOutFile (mixedName.c_str (), (int) sampleRate, 16, 2);

        cout << "allocating audio data..." << endl;
        SoundInfo* info = SoundInfo::instance ();
        info->channels (1);
        info->samplingRate (sampleRate);
        cout << "sr: " << info->samplingRate () << endl;

        // syntehsis oscillator
        SignalTable tab;
        tab.gen (1, 1);
        LoopOscillator osc1 (info, &tab);

        // envelope detector to mimic shape of input signal
        EnvelopeFollower ef (info);
        VariState lp (info);
        lp.cutoff (50);

        // pitch detector
        CorrelationEstimator* correlEstimator = 0;
        correlEstimator = new CorrelationEstimator (
            info,
            (int) win,
            (double) MIN_FREQ,
            (double) MAX_FREQ,
            (int) LEVELS,
            (double) amp,
            (double) SMOOTHINGRATE);

        correlEstimator->smoothingQuality (SMOOTHINGQUALITY);

        long sample = 0;
        cout << "computing data (16 bit shorts)..." << endl << endl;
        clock_t start = clock ();
        double val = -1, oldVal = -1;
        while (!inFile->eof ()) {
            double d = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < channels; ++i) {
                short s;
                inFile->read (&s, sizeof (short));
                d += (double) s / 32768;
            }
            d /= channels;

            val = correlEstimator->process (d);

            double tamp = ef.process (d);
            tamp = lp.process (tamp);
            osc1.amplitude (tamp);
            if (val > MIN_FREQ && val < MAX_FREQ && val != oldVal) {
                osc1.frequency (val);
                oldVal = val;

                cout << "freq: " <<  setw (10) << oldVal << " Hz @ " <<  setw (10) << (double) sample / sampleRate << " sec." << endl;
            }

            short orig = (short) (d * 32768);
            short synth = (short) (osc1.tick () * 32768);
            mixed->write ((short*) &orig, sizeof (short));
            mixed->write ((short*) &synth, sizeof (short));

            ++sample;
        }
        clock_t finish = clock ();
        double duration = (double)(finish - start) / CLOCKS_PER_SEC;
        cout << endl  << "elapsed time: "
            << duration << " sec." << endl << endl;

        inFile->close ();
        mixed->close ();

        delete correlEstimator;
    }
    catch (exception& e) {
        cout << "error: " << e.what () << endl;
    }
    catch (...) {
        cout << "fatal error: unknown exception" << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

// EOF
